tasks.title: control.ts pool primitives — CreatePoolInput/PoolDeliverable types + createPool/collectPool/listPoolMembers/closePoolMembers methods + PerRootData pool maps
tasks.description: Add D13 pool primitives to AgentControl. (A) Top-level exports: `CreatePoolInput`, `CreatePoolResult`, `PoolMemberFailure`, `PoolDeliverable`, `CollectStrategy` (= { type: 'all' } | { type: 'first' } | { type: 'any_n'; n: number }). (B) Extend PerRootData with `poolMembers: Map<string, ReadonlyArray<SessionID>>` (pool_id → ordered member session ids) and `poolOf: Map<SessionID, string>` (session id → pool_id). Initialize in ensureRootSlot; clear in the Session.Event.Deleted subscriber and the disposal finalizer (mirror existing pattern). (C) Add `createPool(input: CreatePoolInput): Effect.Effect<CreatePoolResult>` — generates pool_id via `Identifier.create('pool', 'ascending')`; spawns `input.count` workers via existing spawnAgent under task_names `<task_prefix ?? 'pool'>_<idx>`; per-worker initial message from `per_worker_messages[idx] ?? common_message`; propagates pool_strategy + on_failure to each spawn; tracks members in poolMembers + poolOf; per WAVE.md gotcha 1 the spawn is non-atomic — collect failures into the result's failures array, do NOT abort the whole pool on a single failure; returns { pool_id, members, failures }. (D) Add `collectPool(pool_id, callerID, strategy, timeout_ms?): Effect.Effect<{ deliverables, timed_out }>` — resolves caller's root via senderID (per-root scoping invariant); reads pool members from the slot's poolMembers; subscribes to caller's mailbox seq via subscribeMailboxSeq; peeks mailbox snapshot; collects first message per author whose author path matches a member path AND whose content does NOT start with 'Agent ' + 'reached status:' (filter out completion notifications — deliverables are explicit send_message bodies); strategy: 'all' waits until len(deliverables) === members.length, 'first' returns on first deliverable, 'any_n' returns when len >= n; honors timeout_ms via Effect.timeout; returns deliverables sorted by sent_at AND timed_out boolean. (E) Add `listPoolMembers(pool_id, callerID): Effect.Effect<readonly SessionID[]>` — returns the slot's poolMembers entry or empty array. (F) Add `closePoolMembers(pool_id, callerID, except?): Effect.Effect<void>` — iterates members, calls closeAgent on each except `except` (with callerID as the caller param for the strict-ancestor skip rule). (G) Update Interface, Service.of, and all maps in ensureRootSlot + subscriber teardown + disposal finalizer. (H) Add control.test.ts coverage: at minimum 5 it.live tests under `describe('AgentControl D13 pool primitives', () => { ... })` — createPool count=3 spawns 3 members AND populates poolMembers/poolOf; collectPool 'all' returns 3 deliverables in completion order; collectPool 'first' returns 1 deliverable; closePoolMembers closes all except `except`; createPool with depth-exceeding parent path returns failures array (partial pool tolerance per gotcha 1). All `Effect.fn` named; v4 conventions (no Effect.fork — use forkIn(data.scope)); GOTCHA `agentcontrol-providerref-must-live-in-layer-not-instancestate` respected (no new layer-scope mutable refs — pool state lives in PerRootData).

tasks.title: agent-pool tool — NEW directory packages/opencode/src/tool/agent-pool/ with agent-pool.ts + agent-pool.txt + agent-pool.test.ts
tasks.description: Create the spawn_pool tool. (A) `agent-pool.ts` — `ID = 'spawn_pool' as const`; `PermissionKey = 'task' as const` (collapses onto MULTI_AGENT_TOOLS per gotcha 4); Parameters Schema.Struct fields: `agent_type: Schema.String` (required, validated against subagent-eligible set like spawn_agent); `count: Schema.Number` (must be > 0); `message: Schema.String` (common initial message); `per_worker_messages: Schema.optional(Schema.Array(Schema.String))` (per-worker overrides; length must equal count or be undefined); `collect: Schema.Union(Schema.Literal('all'), Schema.Literal('first'), Schema.Literal('any_n'))` (required); `collect_n: Schema.optional(Schema.Number)` (required when collect === 'any_n'); `pool_strategy: Schema.optional(Schema.Union(Schema.Literal('one_for_one'), Schema.Literal('one_for_all'), Schema.Literal('rest_for_one')))`; `on_failure: Schema.optional(Schema.Union(Schema.Literal('respawn'), Schema.Literal('escalate'), Schema.Literal('ignore'), Schema.Literal('kill_pool')))`; `task_prefix: Schema.optional(Schema.String)` (default 'pool'); `timeout_ms: Schema.optional(Schema.Number)`. Each field annotated with a 1-3 sentence Codex-style description (when, when-not, failure modes). Execute body (Tool.define with Effect.gen): yield AgentControl.Service + Agent.Service; validate count > 0 (errorOutput shape); validate per_worker_messages.length === count when present; validate collect === 'any_n' → collect_n provided AND > 0 AND <= count; validate agent_type against agents.list() (mirror agent-spawn.ts:171-184); resolve currentPath via AgentToolContext.currentAgentPath; ctx.ask({ permission: PermissionKey, patterns: [`pool:${count}`], always: ['*'], metadata: { agent_type, count, collect } }); call control.createPool({ parentID, parentPath, agent_type, count, common_message, per_worker_messages, pool_strategy, on_failure, task_prefix, options: { fork_turns } }); if result.members.length === 0 return errorOutput; build CollectStrategy from collect + collect_n; call control.collectPool(pool_id, ctx.sessionID, strategy, timeout_ms); if collect === 'first' AND deliverables.length > 0: call control.closePoolMembers(pool_id, ctx.sessionID, deliverables[0].worker_session_id); return { title: `spawn_pool ${pool_id}`, metadata: { pool_id, member_paths: members.map(m => String(m.metadata.agent_path)), failures: result.failures, timed_out, collected_count: deliverables.length }, output: JSON.stringify({ pool_id, deliverables: deliverables.map(d => ({ worker: String(d.worker_path), content: d.content })), failures, timed_out }) }. Self-reexport: `export * as AgentPool from './agent-pool'`. (B) `agent-pool.txt` — Codex-quality tool description. Sections: opening 1-3 sentence summary; ## Mental model (declarative fan-out, pool_id is the handle, members get shared pool_id, blocks until collect satisfied); ## Parameters explanation (agent_type, count, collect strategies — all/first/any_n, per_worker_messages vs message); ## Collect semantics (all = wait for every worker, first = race and close losers, any_n = wait for K); ## Partial pools (per gotcha 1 — spawn is non-atomic, failures array surfaces members that failed to spawn); ## Permission (consults `task` key per replace-bash-task precedent; saved `permission.task: { explore: allow }` auto-allows spawn_pool calls under that agent_type); ## Pool strategy (one_for_one isolates, one_for_all cascades — Wave 5 D12); ## Cost (members count against the 64-process pool cap; a `spawn_pool(count: 50)` will likely fail); ## When-not (use spawn_agent for single workers, use this when fan-out is the point). Caveman voice, ~80-130 lines. (C) `agent-pool.test.ts` — minimum 6 it.live tests covering: Parameters Schema accepts valid input; rejects count <= 0; rejects collect='any_n' without collect_n; collect='all' returns all deliverables; collect='first' returns 1 + closes remaining via collectPool then closePoolMembers; permission ask uses PermissionKey 'task'; agent_type_invalid errorOutput on unknown agent_type. Per-file 100% line coverage on agent-pool.ts via `bun test --coverage src/tool/agent-pool/agent-pool.test.ts` (test-file-path form per GOTCHA `bun-test-coverage-source-file-arg-runs-zero-tests`). Tool.define inner gen pattern per GOTCHAS `tool-define-execute-r-must-be-never-capture-services-in-closure` and `instancestate-bound-config-cannot-yield-at-layer-init`.

tasks.title: permission/registry wiring + multi-agent-root.txt 'Routers and pools' prose
tasks.description: Wire spawn_pool into the permission group and the tool registry, and add the 'Routers and pools' prose subsection. (A) `permission/index.ts` MULTI_AGENT_TOOLS const at L336-344 — add 'spawn_pool' to the array (preserve canonical order; insert as the last entry). Single source of truth — `Permission.disabled` walks this; `session/llm.ts:resolveTools`'s `taskGroupDisabled && MULTI_AGENT_TOOLS.includes(k)` check picks it up automatically. (B) `permission/disabled.test.ts` — update the 'MULTI_AGENT_TOOLS exports task + 6 v2 multi-agent IDs in canonical order' test to include 'spawn_pool'; extend the 'groups MULTI_AGENT_TOOLS under task key' test to verify spawn_pool is stripped on wildcard deny. (C) `tool/registry.ts` — add `import { AgentPoolTool } from './agent-pool/agent-pool'` mirroring L18-23; resolve via `const agentpool = yield* AgentPoolTool` and `agentpool: Tool.init(agentpool)` in the Effect.all object; add `tool.agentpool` to the builtin array near the other agent* tools; extend the legacy ID bridge OR chain at L410-415 to include `tool.id === AgentPoolTool.id` (so the call routes its plugin hook through legacy `task` ID — mirror of the existing AgentSpawnTool branch). Also add the tool.agentpool dispatch via `describeSpawnAgent` is NOT required (spawn_pool's agent_type filter shares the same task-key path via permission.evaluate; no separate describe function). (D) `tool/registry.test.ts` — extend the 'registry.tools() for <agent> agent does NOT include bash or task' loop to also assert `expect(ids).toContain('spawn_pool')` for every BUILTIN_AGENTS row. (E) `multi-agent-root.txt` — add a new `## Routers and pools` subsection AFTER the 'Sibling coordination' section (i.e. between L80 and L82 in the post-edit file). Content: brief introduction (5-8 lines) explaining spawn_pool as a first-class fan-out primitive that replaces the manual 'spawn N agents in one message' pattern; list the three collect strategies (all / first / any_n) with 1-line description each; one concrete example use case (e.g. 'race three search strategies via collect: "first"'); references pool_strategy from Wave 5 (one_for_one isolates, one_for_all cascades). Caveman voice consistent with surrounding prose. (F) `subagent-prompts.test.ts` — add new tests under the existing root-doctrine describe block: `multi-agent-root.txt contains 'Routers and pools' subsection header`; `multi-agent-root.txt contains 'spawn_pool' reference`; `multi-agent-root.txt contains 'collect' strategies reference`. NEVER use `--no-verify`; commit follows the wave convention.

tasks.title: INV-D-18..20 integration invariants
tasks.description: Append three new it.instance blocks to packages/opencode/test/integration/multi-agent-invariants.test.ts in the existing `describe('INTEGRATION_INVARIANTS — multi-agent surfaces')` block, AFTER the INV-D-17 block (around L2161). Tests MUST run RED against pre-fix code and GREEN post-fix; if it passes against the broken code, the test is wrong — rewrite it. (A) `INV-D-18-spawn-pool-collect-all-aggregates-results`: register a runLoop that for each invocation emits an assistant message AND uses control.sendInterAgentCommunication to deliver a per-worker text to the spawner (use closure counter to discriminate worker 1/2/3 by sessionID, OR drive via the existing pattern of looking at mailbox.peek to find the seeded message and reply); spawn root; call control.createPool({ count: 3, common_message: 'go', agent_type: undefined, parentPath: AgentPath.root() }); call control.collectPool(pool_id, root.id, { type: 'all' }, 10_000); assert deliverables.length === 3 AND timed_out === false AND each worker_path is one of the spawned member paths AND deliverables are sorted by delivered_at. (B) `INV-D-19-spawn-pool-collect-first-cancels-remaining`: register a runLoop where only worker 1 sends a deliverable promptly (e.g. Effect.sleep(20) for worker 1 then send_message, but workers 2 + 3 use Effect.never so they remain idle); spawn root; createPool count=3; collectPool with strategy { type: 'first' }; assert deliverables.length === 1; then call closePoolMembers(pool_id, root.id, deliverables[0].worker_session_id); within 200ms, listPoolMembers returns the original 3 BUT each non-winner's status is 'shutdown' (or absent from registry.liveAgents). Assert subscribeStatus on each non-winner reads 'shutdown' OR returns AgentNotFoundError. (C) `INV-D-20-spawn-pool-permission-collapses-to-task`: build a ruleset with a single rule `{ permission: 'task', pattern: '*', action: 'allow' }`; call Permission.evaluate('task', 'explore', ruleset) and assert action === 'allow' (sanity); separately call Permission.disabled(['spawn_pool', 'spawn_agent', 'task'], [{ permission: 'task', pattern: '*', action: 'deny' }]) and assert the result Set contains 'spawn_pool' alongside the other MULTI_AGENT_TOOLS members (proves spawn_pool is in the group const and therefore stripped by the wildcard deny — i.e. the permission key COLLAPSES onto 'task'). Test name = invariant slug exactly. Each test self-contained per multi-agent-invariants.test.ts existing pattern; uses `installNeverLoop` where appropriate; the runLoop closures register fresh per test.
